examples.en: I left a comment on the error handling — take a look when you can.
examples.zh: 我在错误处理那块留了条评论，你有空看一下。

situation.en: I'll leave a comment rather than requesting changes — it's a question, not a blocker.
situation.zh: 你评审完想知会作者你已经看过了。

entries.zh: （在 PR 里）留一条评论

examples.en: An inline comment with a code suggestion beats a paragraph of explanation.
examples.zh: 一条带代码建议的行内评论，胜过一大段文字解释。

situation.en: Put it as an inline comment so he sees it in context.
situation.zh: 你在教新人怎么把评审意见写到点子上。

entries.zh: 行内评论（对着某一行代码的）

examples.en: Instead of describing the fix, suggest a change the author can apply with one click.
examples.zh: 与其用文字描述怎么改，不如给出能一键应用的修改建议。

situation.en: I'll suggest a change — simpler than explaining it in prose.
situation.zh: 你评审时想让作者改一行写法，与其打字解释不如直接贴代码。

entries.zh: 给出具体的修改建议（附代码）

examples.en: You need to resolve conflicts with main before this can merge.
examples.zh: 合并之前你得先把和主干的冲突解决了。

situation.en: Resolve conflicts first, then ping me for a fresh look.
situation.zh: 你评审时发现这个 PR 已经跟主干冲突了。

entries.zh: 解决（代码合并）冲突

examples.en: Rebase onto main and the diff shrinks to just your changes.
examples.zh: 变基到最新主干之后，差异就只剩你自己的改动了。

situation.en: Please rebase onto main — half this diff isn't yours.
situation.zh: 你发现 PR 里混进了别人的提交，让作者处理。

entries.zh: 把分支变基到最新主干上

examples.en: Split the PR: config first, then the feature behind a flag.
examples.zh: 把这个 PR 拆开：先合配置，功能放在开关后面再来。

situation.en: I'd rather split the PR than review it badly in one sitting.
situation.zh: 你打开一个八百行的 PR，决定先礼貌地请作者拆分。

entries.zh: 把（太大的）PR 拆成几个小的

examples.en: Open a draft PR early so people can follow the direction.
examples.zh: 早点开个草稿 PR，大家能跟上你的思路方向。

situation.en: This is a draft PR — feedback on the approach, not the polish.
situation.zh: 你想让同事在动手写完之前先对齐方案。

entries.zh: 草稿 PR（还没准备好评审的）

examples.en: Mark it as ready for review once CI passes locally.
examples.zh: 本地 CI 过了之后，把它标记为可评审。

situation.en: It's still a draft — mark as ready for review and I'll jump in.
situation.zh: 作者问你为什么还没人看他的 PR。

entries.zh: 把（草稿）标记为可评审

examples.en: CI is green and two approvals are in — merge when ready.
examples.zh: CI 全过了，两个批准也有了——随时可以合。

situation.en: I don't review until CI is green; half the comments solve themselves.
situation.zh: 你在群里同步 PR 状态，就差合并了。

entries.zh: CI 全部通过了

examples.en: This migration script needs a second pair of eyes before anyone runs it.
examples.zh: 这个迁移脚本在执行之前需要多一个人检查。

situation.en: Get a second pair of eyes on the payment code — always.
situation.zh: 你要改生产数据的脚本，想找人帮你把关。

entries.zh: 第二双眼睛（多一个人检查）

examples.en: Approving in thirty seconds is a rubber-stamp, not a review.
examples.zh: 三十秒就批准，那叫无脑盖章，不叫评审。

situation.en: We don't rubber-stamp here — read the diff or decline the review.
situation.zh: 你发现团队评审流于形式，在复盘里提出来。

entries.zh: 无脑批准、不看就盖章通过

examples.en: Nitpick: this variable name is slightly misleading, but not blocking.
examples.zh: 小问题：这个变量名有点误导，但不阻塞合并。

situation.en: Label nitpicks as nit — authors shouldn't guess what's blocking.
situation.zh: 你想提一个小意见又不想显得在找茬。

entries.zh: 挑小毛病、吹毛求疵；小问题（评论前缀 nit:）

examples.en: Only one blocking comment: the null check. The rest are suggestions.
examples.zh: 只有一条阻塞性意见：那个空值检查。其余都是建议。

situation.en: Mark blocking comments clearly, or everything feels equally urgent.
situation.zh: 你要在评审总结里分清哪些必须改、哪些可选。

entries.zh: 阻塞性意见（必须改才能合）

examples.en: This is a non-blocking suggestion: the helper could be shared with the other module.
examples.zh: 这是个非阻塞建议：这个辅助函数可以和另一个模块共用。

situation.en: Non-blocking suggestion, feel free to ignore: rename for clarity.
situation.zh: 你有个优化想法，但不想拦住这次合并。

entries.zh: 非阻塞建议（可以不改）

examples.en: Is this intentional? The timeout is ten times higher than everywhere else.
examples.zh: 这是有意为之吗？这个超时比其他地方高了十倍。

situation.en: Is this intentional, or a leftover from debugging?
situation.zh: 你评审时看到一处可疑的写法，想先问清是不是故意的。

entries.zh: 这是有意为之吗？（评审里礼貌质疑的开场）

examples.en: Extract a helper here — this is the third copy of the same logic.
examples.zh: 把这里抽成辅助函数吧——同样的逻辑这是第三份了。

situation.en: Extract a helper and both call sites get simpler.
situation.zh: 你评审时看到复制粘贴的代码，想给出建设性意见。

entries.zh: 把（重复逻辑）抽成辅助函数

examples.en: There's leftover debug code in the payment flow — a console log with card data.
examples.zh: 支付流程里有遗留的调试代码——一条打印卡数据的日志。

situation.en: Leftover debug code is the one thing I always scan for before approving.
situation.zh: 你在合并前最后一遍检查发现了问题。

entries.zh: 遗留的调试代码（忘了删的打印、注释）

examples.en: Fixing the bug is half the job — add a regression test so it stays fixed.
examples.zh: 修好 bug 只是一半——加个回归测试，让它别再复发。

situation.en: Please add a regression test that fails on the old code.
situation.zh: 你在评审一个修复 PR，发现没带测试。

entries.zh: 加一个回归测试（防同一个 bug 复发）

examples.en: Attach a before-and-after screenshot for any UI change, please.
examples.zh: UI 改动请附上改动前后的对比截图。

situation.en: A before-and-after screenshot would settle the spacing debate instantly.
situation.zh: 你在评审一个样式 PR，光看代码判断不了效果。

entries.zh: 改动前后的对比截图

examples.en: Link the ticket in the description so reviewers get the background.
examples.zh: 在描述里关联工单，评审的人能看到背景。

situation.en: Always link the ticket — future archaeologists will thank you.
situation.zh: 你在教新人写 PR 的规矩。

entries.zh: （在 PR 里）关联工单、需求单

examples.en: The pull request template asks for test evidence — fill it in, don't delete it.
examples.zh: PR 模板里要求填测试证据——把它填上，别删掉。

situation.en: Our pull request template exists because every section was once missing.
situation.zh: 你发现作者把模板清空了只写了一句话。

entries.zh: PR 模板（预设的描述格式）

examples.en: Do a self-review first — you'll catch half the comments yourself.
examples.zh: 先自己审一遍——一半的评审意见你自己就能提前抓住。

situation.en: My self-review rule: read the diff as if a stranger wrote it.
situation.zh: 你给新人传授减少返工的经验。

entries.zh: （请别人看之前）自己先审一遍

examples.en: Our review turnaround is under four hours, and the team feels it.
examples.zh: 我们的评审周转时间不到四小时，团队能明显感觉到。

situation.en: Slow review turnaround is the hidden tax on every feature.
situation.zh: 你在复盘研发效能，找最大的等待浪费。

entries.zh: 评审周转时间（从提交到评审完成）

examples.en: Changes under payments need a code owner approval, no exceptions.
examples.zh: 支付目录下的改动必须有代码负责人批准，没有例外。

situation.en: Ping the code owner directly — the queue view hides drafts.
situation.zh: 你的 PR 迟迟合不了，缺的正是那一关。

entries.zh: 代码负责人（对某模块有评审权的）

examples.en: Every stale PR is either merged this week or closed with a reason.
examples.zh: 每个陈旧 PR 本周要么合并，要么写明理由关闭。

situation.en: A stale PR rots: conflicts grow and context evaporates.
situation.zh: 你在清理仓库里积压的评审队列。

entries.zh: 放久了没人管的 PR（陈旧 PR）

examples.en: Refactoring the router is out of scope for this PR — file a follow-up instead.
examples.zh: 重构路由不在这个 PR 的范围内——另开一个后续任务吧。

situation.en: Good catch, but out of scope for this PR; I'll track it separately.
situation.zh: 评审的人越提越大，你想守住这次改动的边界。

entries.term: out of scope for this PR
entries.zh: 不在这个 PR 的范围内（评审挡箭牌）

examples.en: The hotfix didn't work — revert the merge and rethink.
examples.zh: 热修复没起作用——把这次合并回滚掉，重新想。

situation.en: Revert the merge now; we can reland it with the fix tomorrow.
situation.zh: 上线后发现新问题，你决定先回滚保平安。

entries.zh: 回滚这次合并

examples.en: The merge queue rebases and retests each PR in order, so main never breaks.
examples.zh: 合并队列会按顺序逐个变基并重跑测试，所以主干不会被合坏。

situation.en: With a merge queue, 'merge when green' stops being a race.
situation.zh: 你在给团队介绍新启用的合并机制。

entries.zh: 合并队列（自动排队逐个合并）

examples.en: Main is a protected branch — nobody pushes to it directly, not even admins.
examples.zh: 主干是受保护分支——没人能直接推，管理员也不行。

situation.en: A protected branch plus required checks is the whole ballgame.
situation.zh: 新同事想直接往 main 推个小修复，你跟他讲规矩。

entries.zh: 受保护分支（不能直推、必须走评审）

examples.en: Resolve a thread only when the fix is pushed, not when it's promised.
examples.zh: 只有修复真的推上去了，才把讨论串标记为已解决。

situation.en: I'll resolve the thread once the new test is in.
situation.zh: 你在教作者怎么收尾评审意见。

entries.zh: 把（评审里的）一条讨论串标记为已解决
